headline: Recommended final passage of O-26-023 increasing sewer use fees, rates and charges, 3-1.
summary: The committee recommended two new appointments, recommended final passage of an ordinance raising sewer use fees, and voted to remove O-26-002 from the table before tabling it again. Ordinances O-26-004 and O-26-005 on camping and recreational vehicle prohibitions were listed but no action was recorded.
decisions: Recommended appointment of Marnie Gordon to the Historic District Commission and re-appointment of Joseph Duquette to the Airport Authority, roll call 4-0.
Recommended final passage of O-26-023, increasing sewer use fees rates and charges, roll call 3-1.
Removed O-26-002 from the table, roll call 4-0.
Tabled O-26-002, allowing electronic public comment for people with walking disabilities, roll call 4-0.
